_comment: Claude Code plugin hooks. PostToolUse: skill invocations are logged ONLY when AI_KIT_USAGE=1 is set in the env. SessionStart: injects a project's already-emitted always-on, high-weight rules (issue #144); no-ops without .claude/rules/, and machine-wide opt-out via bin/ai-kit-no-rule-injection.sh. Both hook scripts are silent + crash-proof by design.
